search_patents.description: Search Google Patents by keyword/boolean query and return top hits. Handles the SPA rendering wait internally.

query.description: Search query: keywords, boolean (AND/OR/NOT), assignee:(Name), inventor:(Name), after:/before: dates.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to extract (default 10, max 50).

returns.description: Array of {title, patent, url, assignee, pubDate, abstract} objects.

get_patent_metadata.description: Open a Google Patents patent page by number and return its bibliographic metadata (title, inventors, assignee, dates, status, abstract, PDF link).

patent.description: Patent publication number, e.g. US11739244B2 or CN115690481A.

extract_search_results.description: Extract the visible search-result rows on the current Google Patents search page (call after navigating).

returns.description: Array of {title, patent, url, assignee, pubDate, abstract}.
